name: [Negative] Poor UI and UX
description: Users have expressed frustration with the app's current design and navigation, citing difficulties with accessing core features, portfolio management, and overall user experience.

name: [Negative] App Experience Issues
description: Users reported a wide range of issues, including app crashes, poor UI/UX, difficulty installing, account hacking, and lack of customer support.

name: [Negative] Poor Customer Support
description: Users are consistently complaining about the lack of effective customer support, with some expressing frustration at not being able to resolve issues with the app, and others suggesting that the chatbots are not helpful.
